name: Tinkering Grenadier [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Training with alchemically inclined allies helps you avoid friendly fire.

Prerequisite(s): Precise Shot or Throw Anything.

Benefit(s): Whenever you hit a creature with a splash weapon, you may choose to exclude one creature within the weapon’s splash area from taking splash damage. If a creature within the splash area also has this feat, it automatically ignores splash damage from your splash weapons on a successful hit.

In addition, if your ally misses with a splash weapon and the errant weapon lands in a square occupied or adjacent to you, you may attempt a DC 20 Reflex save.

If you succeed, you catch the weapon. If you also have the Snatch Arrows feat, you can toss the splash weapon back to your ally as an immediate action.
